title: CondoGuard Nonpayment, Cancellation and Reinstatement Terms by Tier
content:
Figures of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy that govern notices of cancellation for nonpayment, cancellation at the named insured's request, and reinstatement, by tier.

## Nonpayment notice figures (calendar days)

| Tier | Days past due after which a nonpayment notice is issued | Days from the notice to the scheduled cancellation date | Advance notice of cancellation owed to the mortgagee |
|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 15 | 10 | 10 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 15 | 10 | 10 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 15 | 10 | 10 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 15 | 10 | 10 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 15 | 10 | 10 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 15 | 10 | 10 |

## Named-insured cancellation and reinstatement figures

| Tier | Unearned premium basis on a named-insured cancellation | Share of the pro-rata unearned premium kept on a short-rate cancellation (percent) | Premium kept at minimum on a named-insured midterm cancellation (USD) | Reinstatement window (calendar days) | Reinstatement fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | short rate | 10 | 75.00 | 15 | 25.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | pro rata | 0 | 50.00 | 30 | 25.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | pro rata | 0 | 50.00 | 30 | 25.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | pro rata | 0 | 50.00 | 30 | 20.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | pro rata | 0 | 25.00 | 30 | 0.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | pro rata | 0 | 0.00 | 45 | 0.00 |

## Notes

- CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential is the only tier whose named-insured cancellation basis is short rate; on it the carrier keeps 10 percent of the pro-rata unearned premium. On the other five tiers the basis is pro rata and the share kept is 0.
- A reinstatement fee of 0.00, as on CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier and CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature, means no fee at reinstatement.
